name: @biz-hub/mcp-server

tools.name: products_list
tools.description: List products in the marketplace with optional filters by category, seller, sort order, and pagination. Returns product name, price, stock, status, and category.

category.description: Filter by category slug (use categories_list to find slugs)

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return

tools.name: products_get
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific product by its URL slug. Returns full product details including description, images, pricing, stock, seller info, and category.

tools.name: products_create
tools.description: Create a new product in the marketplace. Requires name, description, price, and category ID (use categories_list to find available categories). Optionally accepts store, inventory count, badge, and images.

store.description: Store ID to associate the product with

tools.name: products_update
tools.description: Update an existing product's price, inventory count, or status. Provide only the fields you want to change.

status.description: Set to DRAFT to hide, ACTIVE to list

tools.name: products_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a product from the marketplace by its slug. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: orders_list
tools.description: List orders from your store. Optionally filter by status (pending, completed, refunded, cancelled). Returns order ID, amount, quantity, status, product name, and buyer info.

tools.name: orders_get
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific order by its ID. Returns full order details including product, buyer, amount, quantity, status, and timeline.

tools.name: orders_update_status
tools.description: Update the status of an order. Use this to mark orders as completed (fulfilled), refunded, or cancelled. Cannot revert a completed/refunded/cancelled order back to pending.

status.description: New status: completed = fulfilled, refunded = money returned, cancelled = order voided

reason.description: Optional reason for the status change (e.g., refund reason)

tools.name: inventory_list
tools.description: View inventory levels across all products. Shows stock count, price, and status. Use lowStock=true to filter for products with stock at or below 5 units that may need restocking.

lowStock.description: If true, only show products with stock ≤ 5

tools.name: inventory_update
tools.description: Update the stock count for a specific product by slug. Use this to restock items, adjust inventory after physical counts, or correct stock levels.

slug.description: Product slug to update stock for

stock.description: New stock count (0 = out of stock)

tools.name: discounts_apply
tools.description: Apply a percentage discount to a product. Calculates the sale price automatically and preserves the original price. Use this for sales, promotions, and seasonal discounts.

slug.description: Product slug to apply discount to

label.description: Optional label for the sale (e.g., 'Summer Sale')

tools.name: discounts_remove
tools.description: Remove the sale price from a product, restoring it to its original price. Use this when a promotion ends.

slug.description: Product slug to remove discount from

tools.name: discounts_list
tools.description: List all products that currently have active discounts or sale prices. Shows original price, current sale price, and percentage off.

tools.name: analytics_get
tools.description: Get store performance analytics including total orders, completed orders, total revenue, average order value, unique customers, and pending orders. This is your store's health overview.

tools.name: customers_list
tools.description: List all customers who have purchased from your store, along with their order count, lifetime total spend, and last order date. Sorted by total spend descending.

tools.name: stores_list
tools.description: List all stores in the marketplace with their name, rating, product count, and verification status.

tools.name: categories_list
tools.description: List all product categories available in the marketplace. Use this to find category slugs and IDs for filtering products or creating new products.
